thesis.title: HOOD — HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY: Q3 2024 total net revenues +36% YoY (SEC Exhibit 99.1)
thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY CANDIDATE THESIS (not a current view, not a recommendation). Basis: a single issuer-reported SEC disclosure — Robinhood Markets, Inc. Q3 2024 (quarter ended 2024-09-30), released 2024-10-30, Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K, source https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387924000295/q32024robinhoodexhibit991.htm (SHA-256 27ba615060da18f74984973ec4c16a5a67f6215b2d3d91648c375f1192f3c973). The issuer's own top-line label is "total net revenues" (not "total revenue"), reported at USD 637 million for Q3 2024 with a reported YoY growth of 36%, which clears the frozen adapter's single rule of issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY >= 20%. That rule is a one-factor disclosure screen only; passing it does not establish that HOOD was or is an attractive investment, and no share price, valuation multiple, analyst target, or forward return is in evidence here. Key reported figures (USD millions unless noted, issuer-reported, GAAP-basis net income): total net revenues 637; net income 150; transaction-based revenues 319; crypto revenues 61 with reported crypto revenue YoY +165%; operating expenses YoY -10%; regulatory accrual 10 in Q3 2024 versus 104 in Q3 2023. MATERIAL COUNTERPOINT FROM A DIFFERENT SUPPLIED FIELD: the reported -10% YoY decline in operating expenses coincides with a regulatory accrual that fell from 104 to 10 (a 94 million reduction). Because the expense line is reported as a YoY change rather than an absolute level, the packet does not let us decompose how much of the expense decline is operating leverage versus the lapsing of a large prior-year legal/regulatory charge — so the expense-side improvement should not be read as evidence of durable cost discipline. DISCRIMINATING FOLLOW-UP QUESTION: what were absolute Q3 2024 and Q3 2023 operating expense levels, and what portion of the YoY decline is attributable to the 94 million lower regulatory accrual versus recurring operating costs? EXPLICIT BOUNDARY: no price, market capitalization, valuation multiple, or expected-return evidence is present in this packet; any valuation judgment is out of scope and must not be inferred. Scope limits: historical single-issuer disclosure screen from a frozen offline SEC-source adapter, not live market data; no peer ranking on a common date; no trading action taken.
assumptions: The issuer's reported 'total net revenues' of USD 637 million for Q3 2024 and reported +36% YoY are as stated in Exhibit 99.1 to the 2024-10-30 Form 8-K (SHA-256 27ba615060da18f74984973ec4c16a5a67f6215b2d3d91648c375f1192f3c973).
The frozen adapter's single rule (issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY >= 20%) is a disclosure screen only and carries no valuation or return implication.
Reported figures are taken at face value from the packet; no independent recomputation of YoY rates was performed.
catalysts: Future issuer disclosure giving absolute operating expense levels, enabling separation of the 94 million lower regulatory accrual from recurring cost trends.
Future issuer disclosure on the durability of crypto revenue (61 million, reported +165% YoY) as a share of transaction-based revenues (319 million).
invalidations: A restatement or correction showing Q3 2024 total net revenues materially below the reported 637 million or YoY growth below 20%.
Evidence that the reported -10% operating expense YoY change is fully explained by the 94 million lower regulatory accrual, removing the operating-leverage interpretation.
Evidence that the reported crypto revenue growth is non-recurring or reverses materially.

message.content:
# HOOD — Historical SEC-Disclosure Candidate Research (Outcome: RETAINED)

## 1. Screen call and result
`finance-tools__screen_stocks` was called once with `market=US`, `symbols=["HOOD"]`, `require_complete=false`. Result: **passed=1, failed=0, rejected=[]**, completeness 0.9762, no quality flags. Fixture `FINTECH-SEC-SCREEN-HOLDOUT-v1`, `offline_frozen_adapter=true`, `not_live_market_data=true`, as_of 2026-10-22T11:57:58Z.

This adapter applies **one** rule only: issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY ≥ 20%. It is not a live quote and not a seven-factor completeness screen. Its own basis warning states that issuer top-line labels differ (total revenue vs. total net revenues), that only each issuer's own YoY disclosure or matched prior-year calculation may be applied, and that issuers must never be ranked by these rates or the threshold met with a substitute metric.

## 2. Retained item — reported fields
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Issuer | Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD) |
| Period | Q3 2024, quarter ended 2024-09-30 |
| Release date | 2024-10-30 |
| Source | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387924000295/q32024robinhoodexhibit991.htm |
| SHA-256 (full) | `27ba615060da18f74984973ec4c16a5a67f6215b2d3d91648c375f1192f3c973` |
| Locator | "Third Quarter Results revenue and expense bullets" |
| Top-line label | **total_net_revenues** (issuer's own label — not "total revenue") |
| Total net revenues | USD 637 million |
| Top-line YoY (reported) | +36% |
| Net income | USD 150 million (GAAP) |
| Transaction-based revenues | USD 319 million |
| Crypto revenues | USD 61 million; reported YoY +165% |
| Operating expenses YoY (reported) | −10% |
| Regulatory accrual | USD 10 million (Q3 2024) vs USD 104 million (Q3 2023) |

Criterion applied: 36% ≥ 20% → **retained**. Units are USD millions; the top-line metric basis is the issuer's reported "total net revenues" line, and net income is issuer-reported GAAP.

## 3. Material counterpoint from a different supplied field
The screen outcome rests on the revenue line. The most material counterpoint comes from the **operating expense** field read against the **regulatory accrual** field: the reported −10% YoY decline in operating expenses coincides with a regulatory accrual that fell from USD 104 million to USD 10 million — a USD 94 million reduction. Because the packet supplies operating expenses only as a YoY percentage and not as absolute levels, the packet does not permit decomposing how much of the expense decline reflects operating leverage versus the lapsing of a large prior-year legal/regulatory charge. The expense-side improvement therefore should not be read as evidence of durable cost discipline, and the margin/earnings quality implied by the revenue beat is less clean than the headline growth rate suggests.

A secondary observation, not the primary counterpoint: crypto revenues (USD 61 million, +165% YoY) are a fast-growing but comparatively small slice of transaction-based revenues (USD 319 million), so the growth mix carries concentration in a historically volatile revenue category.

## 4. Discriminating follow-up question
What were the **absolute** Q3 2024 and Q3 2023 operating expense levels, and what portion of the reported −10% YoY decline is attributable to the USD 94 million lower regulatory accrual versus recurring operating costs? This question discriminates between "structural cost discipline" and "prior-year charge roll-off" — two explanations the current packet cannot separate.

## 5. Explicit missing price/valuation boundary
The packet contains **no** share price, market capitalization, valuation multiple, analyst target, or forward-return evidence; the adapter explicitly excludes `share_price`, `valuation`, `analyst_target`, `future_return`, and `current_market_data`. No valuation judgment is made or implied. Passing this single disclosure rule does **not** mean HOOD was or is an attractive investment.

## 6. Thesis saved
Exactly one thesis was created: `th_ac9488afe4d2426ca757`, status `researching`, conviction 2, market US, symbol HOOD, titled as a **HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY** candidate. Structured evidence carries all nine fact IDs with full source URL, full SHA-256, release date, period, units, and metric basis, plus the screen-rule record. `next_review_at` was omitted (left null) because no genuinely future-dated review date was established.

## 7. Scope and integrity notes
- No trades, no live market tools, no peer ranking on a common date, and no claim that the screen pass implies attractiveness.
- All figures are as reported in the packet; no YoY rates were independently recomputed and no derived numbers were introduced.
- Fields absent from this packet are **packet omissions only** — they are not asserted to be omissions from the SEC filing itself.
